features: Fixes Production migration tracking for legacy bdc_schema_migrations tables whose version primary key was limited to VARCHAR(50)
Expands bdc_schema_migrations.version to VARCHAR(191) before migration discovery so long migration filenames are no longer truncated into duplicate primary keys
New installations now create the migration version key at VARCHAR(191)
Preserves all existing migration history rows and does not delete or manually rewrite Production migration records
Rejects future migration identifiers longer than the supported 191 characters
Keeps Production automatic backup, migration diagnostics, health verification and rollback behavior unchanged
No Staging or Production deployment performed
